Class GameAnimator

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.GameAnimator
public class GameAnimator extends Object
Owns all JavaFX transitions for the game screen. Contains no state-machine logic.

Modal animations (event card reveal) are serialised through an internal queue so that concurrent events never produce overlapping overlays.

    • animateDeckDeal

      public void animateDeckDeal(javafx.scene.image.ImageView deck, javafx.scene.Node target)
      Enqueues a single deck-to-board deal: flip the source once and fly the target out from it. Plays in turn with all other queued animations.
      Parameters:
      deck - the deck ImageView to animate from
      target - the board node to populate (shown mid-flip)

    • animateDeckDealMulti

      public void animateDeckDealMulti(javafx.scene.image.ImageView source, List<javafx.scene.Node> targets)
      Enqueues one deal per freshly-added card from a single source, so the cards are dealt one at a time. Used when a whole row is refilled (start of turn) or revealed (age change).
      Parameters:
      source - the deck/covered-stack ImageView to animate from
      targets - the board nodes to populate (each flies out from the source)

    • animateCardDiscard

      public void animateCardDiscard(javafx.scene.image.ImageView card, Runnable onDone)
      Fade-out a card, then calls onDone so the caller can remove the node.
      Parameters:
      card - the card ImageView to fade out
      onDone - called on JavaFX thread after the fade completes

    • animateTopToBottom

      public void animateTopToBottom(javafx.scene.image.ImageView card, double fromY, double toY, Runnable onDone)
      Translates a card vertically from fromY to toY (top-row → bottom-row).
      Parameters:
      card - the card ImageView to move
      fromY - starting Y in scene coordinates
      toY - ending Y in scene coordinates
      onDone - called after the animation completes

    • animateCardToHand

      public void animateCardToHand(javafx.scene.image.ImageView card, double targetX, double targetY, boolean isLocal, Runnable onDone)
      Translates a card from its current scene position toward the target coordinates. If isLocal is false the card fades out on arrival (opponent hand — not directly visible).
      Parameters:
      card - the card ImageView to move
      targetX - destination X in scene coordinates
      targetY - destination Y in scene coordinates
      isLocal - true if the destination is the local player hand
      onDone - called after the animation (including fade) completes

    • animateEventCardReveal

      public void animateEventCardReveal(javafx.scene.layout.AnchorPane contentPane, javafx.scene.image.Image cardImage)
      Enqueues a modal event-card reveal so concurrent events never overlap. Animations play sequentially; the next one starts only after the overlay fades out.
      Parameters:
      contentPane - the 1280×720 reference pane to host the overlay
      cardImage - the event card image to reveal
